text_simplified: This text discusses Prophetic hadiths related to the tarbiyah (upbringing and nurturing) of children and their education, along with some narrations from the Companions. It highlights the importance of religious guidance in raising a child. Parents can benefit from these values in reinforcing positive behavior in their children.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the common word 'تربية' (upbringing/education), not a technical Islamic term requiring transliteration. Using 'Tarbiyah' in the English title introduces unnecessary jargon and makes the title less accessible to general readers, whereas the Arabic is simple and direct.
